line: Tonight in Jozi, I’m in Jozi
vault_lines: Tonight in Jozi, I'm in Jozi
meaning: Johannesburg is informally referred to as Jozi.

line: Peru para Peru para Peru para Peru para Peru para Peru para Peru para
vault_lines: I been wantin' you so bad (Peru, para)
meaning:
In this line, Fireboy DML is paying homage to Peruzzi’s 2019 song with MC Galaxy ohaa remix in which he sings: “Gwara gwara for baby, see I’m loo-oo. Shaku shaku for daddy eh”.

In a song with Dj Ecool and Davido, the singer said: “Baby I’m loosing con control”

Fireboy is referring to loosing control in this line, also known as Para in the Nigerian pidgin language.

line: Mo n kọrin fúnwọn, wọn jó ṣi
vault_lines: Mo n korin funwon won jo si
meaning: In Yoruba this means “I’m singing to them”
This is a reference to the eleventh song on Ed’s fifth album, “Love In Slow Motion”. It also talks about how he was enjoying his life.
